_comment: Home Assistant version the e2e suite runs against. Pinned so a failing scenario means hm2mqtt changed, not that Home Assistant released. Bump deliberately, and re-check both the config entry storage version in harness/homeAssistant.ts and paho-mqtt below (it is the MQTT integration's own requirement, which Home Assistant would normally pip-install at runtime — the suite runs with --skip-pip). The frontend and numpy are not used by the scenarios; without them Home Assistant falls back to recovery mode and never loads the MQTT entry.
